holdings.name: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd

what_changed.text: Aurobindo completed the acquisition of A1 Labs LLC on October 2, 2026 for USD 15.247 million, while Apitoria completed the A1 Biochem Group business acquisition for an 80% stake in A1 Labs India and its U.S. unit.
The company received USFDA final approval for Perampanel Tablets.
Aurobindo recalled over 1.1 lakh bottles of paracetamol in the United States.

expected.text: Management planned the commercial launch of Perampanel Tablets in Q3FY27.

holdings.why_it_matters: Aurobindo Pharma is the fund's largest position at 10.71% and was the primary positive contributor over the last 3 months, delivering an 8.36% return and adding an estimated 0.895% to fund performance.

watch.text: Execution of the commercial rollout of Perampanel Tablets slated for Q3FY27.

holdings.name: Lloyds Metals and Energy Ltd

what_changed.text: The board approved raising funds via NCDs up to Rs 3,000 crore and USD notes up to $130 million, while cancelling a previously planned Rs 600 crore issuance.
A total of 3.5 crore shares of Thriveni Earthmovers and Infra Private Limited valued at Rs 606.76 crore were credited to the company's demat account on October 8, 2026.
CARE ESG assigned the company an ESG score of 76.7 and a CareEdge-ESG 1 rating.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 9.04% fund weight, Lloyds Metals is the second-largest holding; its modest 3-month decline of 1.76% kept it relatively flat in contribution despite a 16.34% gain over 6 months.

watch.text: Progress and closing of the approved Rs 3,000 crore NCD and $130 million USD notes issuances.

holdings.name: Tata Communications Ltd

what_changed.text: Quarterly net profit rose 86% year-on-year to Rs 336-341 crore for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, while revenue grew roughly 10% to Rs 6,688 crore.
The board approved the internal transfer of Kaleyra to TCNL and appointed Ridhi Sood as Company Secretary effective November 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carrying an 8.49% portfolio weight, the stock fell 4.90% over the trailing 3 months, detractor status (-0.416% estimated contribution), though it posted a sharp earnings recovery at quarter-end.

watch.text: Completion and operational integration of the Kaleyra transfer to TCNL.

holdings.name: Indus Towers Ltd

what_changed.text: The company entered into a memorandum of understanding with Cygni Energy to develop energy storage systems for telecom infrastructure.
Niche Ninety Nine assigned the company an ESG score of 69.86 with a Leader rating on September 17, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Indus Towers represents 6.01% of the fund and declined 5.93% over 3 months and 7.64% over 6 months, acting as a persistent drag on the fund's technology and communications allocation.

watch.text: Board consideration of audited Q2 and half-year FY26 financial results scheduled for October 27, 2026.

holdings.name: IRB Infrastructure Developers Ltd

what_changed.text: September 2026 gross toll revenue rose 24% year-on-year to Rs 773 crore.
The company completed the transfer of projects SYTL and CGTL from IRB Infrastructure Trust to IRB InvIT Fund on September 30, 2026.
CARE assigned AA; Stable on Rs 459 crore long-term facilities, while Fitch affirmed BB+ and Moody's affirmed Ba1 ratings with stable outlooks.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 5.70% weight, IRB Infra was one of the fund's biggest detractors over 3 months, declining 12.89% and shaving an estimated 0.735% off fund returns.

watch.text: Execution of board-approved non-core asset monetisation initiatives.

holdings.name: LG Electronics India Ltd.

what_changed.text: The company rolled out 15 semi-automatic washing machine models with plans to start exports to over 10 countries in 2027.
Customs authorities issued a show-cause notice proposing duty recovery of Rs 153.57 crore over alleged royalty under-inclusion.
Production was scaled up to satisfy festive season consumer demand alongside the launch of the Diwali Celebration of Trust promotional campaign.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 5.09% weight, the stock gained 9.41% in 3 months, contributing an estimated +0.479% to fund returns, supporting the fund's consumer discretionary exposure.

watch.text: Legal and financial resolution of the Rs 153.57 crore customs show-cause notice regarding royalty inclusion.

holdings.name: Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd

what_changed.text: For Q2 FY27, revenue rose 24% and net profit rose 120% year-on-year, while the total order book stood at Rs 2.58 lakh crore.
The board sanctioned Rs 500 crore for additional facilities at HEEP-Haridwar and cleared an internal merger effective November 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 5.03% weight, BHEL is up 40.42% over 6 months and 84.16% over 1 year, anchoring the 15.1% Industrials allocation despite a flat 3-month performance (-0.26%).

watch.text: Implementation of the Haridwar capacity expansion and completion of the merger effective November 1, 2026.

holdings.name: Nippon Life India Asset Management Ltd

what_changed.text: SES ESG revised the company's ESG score to 75.7 from 77 on September 27, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 4.67% weight, Nippon Life AMC represents almost the entirety of the fund's 5.1% Financials allocation and fell 5.45% over 3 months.

watch.text: Board meeting on October 22, 2026 to review Q2/H1 FY27 results and deliberate on an interim dividend.

holdings.name: Premier Energies Ltd.

what_changed.text: The company secured orders worth Rs 4,001 crore for 2,308 MW solar cell and module supplies during Q2 FY27 and commissioned a 7 GW TOPCon facility.
A wholly owned subsidiary, PE Horizon Pte. Ltd., was incorporated in Singapore on September 23, 2026.
A share allotment and shareholders agreement was executed between Premier Battery Technologies, Premier Energies Storage Solutions, and RCT Nexor Energy on October 15, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 4.59% weight, Premier Energies was the fund's largest individual negative contributor over 3 months (-0.774% estimated contribution), falling 16.86%.

watch.text: Operational progress and production ramp-up at the newly commissioned 7 GW TOPCon manufacturing unit.

holdings.name: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd

what_changed.text: The company mutually terminated its Chennai captive solar project agreement with Seeyel Renewables effective September 25, 2026 citing altered power requirements, with no operational disruption.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 4.04% portfolio weight, Sona BLW gained 17.21% over the trailing 3 months, generating the second-largest positive contribution (+0.695% estimated) for the portfolio.

watch.text: Board meeting and earnings call scheduled for October 26, 2026 to review Q2 and half-year FY27 performance.

portfolio.statement: Quant Mid Cap Fund holds a concentrated 63.4% top-10 exposure, where sharp gains in healthcare and auto components were overshadowed by severe corrections in clean energy, infrastructure, and utilities, leading to a 3-month return of -4.56%.
interp: Top contributors Aurobindo Pharma (+8.36%) and Sona BLW (+17.21%) provided roughly 1.59% in combined estimated contribution, cushioned by festive consumer demand in LG Electronics India (+9.41%).
However, three top-10 positions—Premier Energies (-16.86%), IRB Infrastructure (-12.89%), and Tata Communications (-4.90%)—drew down more than 1.9% of portfolio value over the same three-month span.
portfolio.line: Performance was dominated by sharp divergence: domestic industrial and discretionary momentum offset steep sell-offs in infrastructure and renewable energy.

drivers.text: Healthcare strength led by top holding Aurobindo Pharma, which delivered an 8.36% 3-month return following US acquisitions and product approvals.
Steep valuation drawdowns in renewable energy supplier Premier Energies (-16.86% 3M return) and transport infrastructure developer IRB Infra (-12.89% 3M return).
Resilient quarterly operational prints in capital goods and technology hardware, exemplified by BHEL's 120% profit growth and Tata Communications' 86% net profit rise.

themes.title: Industrial & Energy Transition
themes.text: Significant deployment across heavy manufacturing, renewable energy supply chains, and power equipment, facing divergent near-term valuation pressures.

themes.title: Consumer Discretionary & Automotive Tech
themes.text: Beneficiaries of seasonal festive volume ramp-ups and component supply expansions.

themes.title: Telecom & Digital Infrastructure
themes.text: Exposure to network expansion and telecom enterprise digital offerings undergoing internal restructuring.

macro.why: Aggressive order book expansion and capacity additions directly drive revenues, though equity returns have seen near-term corrections.
Toll collections are growing at double digits (24% YoY in September) as road developers transfer matured operational highway assets into InvIT vehicles.

priced_in.text: Robust order book build-up at Bharat Heavy Electricals, with investors pricing in a Rs 2.58 lakh crore order pipeline after a 84.16% 1-year rally.
Substantial manufacturing order backlog at Premier Energies, where fresh orders of Rs 4,001 crore have failed to reverse a 16.86% 3-month share price drop.

could_change.title: Litigation and Customs Liabilities
could_change.text: Potential resolution or escalation of the Rs 153.57 crore customs royalty recovery notice issued to LG Electronics India.

could_change.title: Execution of Capital Raising in Metals
could_change.text: Completion and financial terms of the Rs 3,000 crore NCDs and $130 million foreign currency notes authorised by Lloyds Metals.

portfolio.risk_note: With a high portfolio beta of 0.86, historical drawdown of -25.95%, and top 10 holdings accounting for 63.4% of assets, the portfolio remains vulnerable to idiosyncratic project execution and valuation compressions across its industrial, infrastructure, and energy bets.
